title: Sharḥ-i Dah Bayt-i Muḥyī l-Dīn Ibn-i ʿArabī
transliterated_title: Sharḥ-i Dah Bayt-i Muḥyī l-Dīn Ibn-i ʿArabī (Commentary on Ten Verses by Ibn ʿArabī; variant Sharḥ-i Abyātī az Ibn-i ʿArabī)

date.ce: not later than 17 April 1435 (a posthumous copy date)
date.basis: The only date given is the MS Majlis 10196 copy date, which falls after Ibn Turka's death (835/1432 per the timeline); no composition date is stated.

summary: An exposition of select Ibn ʿArabī verses, especially on the difference between wujūd and kawn.
